_comment: Mutation testing for the score engine and the rest of packages/core. Coverage proves a line ran; this proves a WRONG line fails a test. packages/core is the right and only first target: it is pure TS with no I/O (core.md), so mutants are deterministic, and the Aura invariant is the highest-stakes logic in the repo. Run with `pnpm --filter @athanor/core mutation`.
_plugins_comment: Declared explicitly: Stryker's default plugin discovery globs node_modules and does not follow pnpm's symlinked layout, so the runner is installed and resolvable but not auto-loaded.
_thresholds_comment: `break` is the CI gate (.github/workflows/mutation.yml) and is set just under the measured score — 90.59% on the first run, 91.41% after killing the four Aura-path survivors it found — never aspirationally, because a threshold nobody can meet becomes a red job people learn to ignore. Ratchet UP as tests improve, never down (core.md precedent, same rule as the coverage floors).
